核心產品

四大引擎。一個合規棧。

From real-time risk detection to autonomous on-chain execution — every layer designed for institutions that operate at scale.

風險雷達

實時情報

Aggregate risk data from Chainalysis, Elliptic, and OFAC in a single query. Every address scored, every transaction monitored, every decision traceable — in under 50 milliseconds. Build your own risk models or use our pre-configured scoring.

Chainalysis Elliptic OFAC <50ms

策略引擎

可編程規則

Define compliance rules as executable code: KYC thresholds, transaction limits, geographic restrictions, time locks. Rules are enforced at the smart contract level — no exceptions, no delays, no manual intervention required.

KYC/AML Tx Limits Geo-Fencing Multi-Sig

審計 Shield

不可篡改合規

Every decision, every override, every policy change — permanently recorded on-chain with cryptographic proofs. Generate regulator-ready reports for HKMA, SEC, and MiCA with a single API call. 審計-ready from day one.

HKMA SEC MiCA Immutable

不可篡改合規日誌

01

Risk Intelligence 接入ion

Pull real-time risk signals from Chainalysis, Elliptic, TRM Labs, and OFAC sanction lists. Our Risk Oracle aggregates and normalizes multi-source data into a unified risk score — updated continuously, not batched.

02

策略評估

The 策略引擎 evaluates each transaction against your configurable rule set — KYC status, transaction limits, geographic restrictions, velocity checks, and custom business logic. Sub-50ms evaluation latency.

03

鏈上執行

已批准交易通過審計過的智能合約執行。被拒絕的交易在飛行前攔截，詳細的合規原因不可篡改地記錄上鏈。不會因不合規交易浪費Gas。

04

審計 & Reporting

Every action generates an immutable audit trail with cryptographic proofs. Generate regulator-ready compliance reports for HKMA, SEC, and MiCA via API or dashboard — ready for your next regulatory audit.
